findings: Original VectorApple has no OutputIntents and uses DeviceCMYK, Indexed/DeviceCMYK, and DeviceN with DeviceCMYK alternate
DefaultCMYK control changes 32606 Poppler pixels while native pixels stay bit-identical to the original native result
Full-page mean absolute channel error falls from 4.0044 to 1.8246 but maximum error remains 212; profile policy is a contributor, not complete root cause
Opaque-cross interior of one isolated patch has mean error 2.6721 without explicit ICC and 0.6277 with matching ICC; maximum interior error falls from 6 to 3
Current isolated native patch has 139 fractional-alpha pixels; older binary-only-alpha diagnostic no longer describes current behavior
Inspected Hayro render(): explicit viewport width and height do not rescale artwork; decoder unit scale is applied independently. No page-rescaling change was made.
limitations: Counterfactual profile alignment, not qualification of original AI equality
Native ignoring an explicit DefaultCMYK which equals its own built-in profile does not prove general DefaultCMYK support
Opaque cross-neighborhood is defined from native coverage, not independent oracle coverage
Native binary source matches current production rendering path; adaptive helper APIs added later are not invoked by this binary
Device-default profiles, rendering intent, nonlinear color integration, geometry coverage and other operators still need separate verification
No production files edited this turn
next_action: Qualify explicit resource DefaultCMYK on a deterministic independent-color fixture, including nested resources/shadings/images and cache context isolation; preserve strict original-file oracle gate and separately localize remaining edge/sampling discrepancies.
